brief:
Read <scratch> first; <dir> is that folder and <you> is "dana".
You are Dana Kim's AI agent (REST or MCP; token <dir>/dana-token.json; start at http://localhost:8810/llms.txt). Another tester also uses Dana's token for a different job — leave jobs you didn't post alone. Dana said: "Our 50-gallon gas water heater at 78704 is leaking from the bottom. Replace it, permit and all, within $2,400. I want to pay in stages, keep some back until we know it works, and have a real inspector sign off." Do it end to end: post with the options matching what she asked (milestones, retainage, warranty, inspector, BEFORE photos, review window), review the scope, wait for offers, negotiate once, accept, follow each milestone to payout. Whenever the server says a person must act, give Dana exactly what the server gives you to hand her, then act as Dana by opening that link and making the choice she'd make (she releases only what passed; she doesn't waive the inspection), noting each time. If a milestone waits on the inspector, say so and act as the inspector only through the site's own demo sign-in for inspectors (note it). Use "finish now" only if nothing moves for 5 minutes (note it). Don't move the platform clock unless the server says the window hasn't opened (note it). Report every money step (held, each partial capture, payouts, retainage) with ids and whether totals add up.
